name: Coaching 1:1
description: A Scrum-coach 1:1 template — wins, blockers, feedback both ways, commitments, and the next check-in. Growth-oriented, action-tracking.

sections.title: Context
sections.instruction: One line: who the 1:1 was with (role) and its focus (career, delivery, blocker, general check-in)

sections.title: Wins & Progress
sections.instruction: Summarize progress, wins, or things going well since the last session as short factual bullets

sections.title: Blockers & Challenges
sections.instruction: List the blockers, frustrations, or challenges raised, with enough context to act on each

sections.title: Feedback Exchanged
sections.instruction: Capture feedback given AND received during the session, kept factual and constructive. Separate 'gave' from 'received' if both occurred

sections.title: Commitments
sections.instruction: List concrete commitments made in the session, with owner and due date, and a reference segment + timestamp for traceability

sections.title: Next Check-in
sections.instruction: State when the next 1:1 is and any specific topic to revisit. If not set, write 'To be scheduled'
